application: Third-Party Cyber Risk Vendor Assurance Toolkit
limitations: Validation checks the supplied CSV state; it cannot recover a prior file version that was never preserved.
Evidence record IDs, audit events and assessment versions provide the available history trail.
This phase does not calculate security risk, evidence scores or decisions.
scope: Phase 2 implements semantic validation and vendor criticality calculation only. Risk scoring, evidence scoring, decision workflow, remediation workflow, management reporting and the Streamlit interface are later-phase work.
